decisive_items: Biopsy of the umbilical lesion demonstrated a well-differentiated, infiltrating adenocarcinoma
irregular, circumferential thickening of the right third of the transverse colon measuring approximately 8.3 cm
Total colonoscopy revealed no endoluminal lesion
response.rationale: Umbilical adenocarcinoma with colonic wall thickening and no luminal lesion indicates metastatic spread from an occult colonic primary, fitting Sister Mary Joseph nodule. R1 only names colorectal cancer without addressing the umbilical metastasis.

rejected.why: Lacks the umbilical nodule and metastatic context, which are central to the presentation.
